name: Lunar Calendar
author: Gary Liu
description: Chinese lunar calendar with typed schedule, festival, and event subscriptions

barWidget.description: Chinese lunar calendar with typed subscription overlays

schema.label: Show subscription data
schema.description: Render date-specific schedule overrides, subscribed festivals, and events. The base weekly rest schedule remains active.

schema.label: Saturday is a regular rest day
schema.description: Base weekly schedule. A date-specific subscribed 休 or 班 record takes precedence.

schema.label: Sunday is a regular rest day
schema.description: Base weekly schedule. A date-specific subscribed 休 or 班 record takes precedence.

schema.label: Rest badge color
schema.description: Use auto or #RRGGBB. Auto selects an accessible red for the current light or dark theme.

schema.label: Work badge color
schema.description: Use auto or #RRGGBB. Auto selects an accessible blue for the current light or dark theme.

schema.label: China statutory holiday source
schema.description: Enable the built-in structured source for official days off and make-up workdays.

schema.label: Holiday JSON URL template
schema.description: HTTPS holiday-cn-json template. Keep the literal {year} placeholder.

schema.label: Holiday source refresh period (hours)
schema.description: Minimum age before the official source is checked again.

schema.label: Automatic subscription updates
schema.description: Master switch for startup, open, and periodic background checks. Manual refresh remains available.

schema.label: Background check interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often the shell asks the helper to check for stale sources.

schema.label: Check after shell startup
schema.description: Check stale subscription sources after Omarchy Shell starts.

schema.label: Check when calendar opens
schema.description: Check stale subscription sources when the calendar popup opens.
